data.description:
## Context
Codex currently has no Serena MCP entry, while this project already relies on Serena/Pyright for semantic navigation and Claude is configured to launch Serena from `git+https://github.com/oraios/serena`. The current Codex manual supports project-scoped MCP servers in trusted `.codex/config.toml`; Serena currently provides a `codex` context and `--project-from-cwd` specifically for CLI agents and worktrees.

## Plan
- Add a project-scoped `mcp_servers.serena` STDIO entry to `.codex/config.toml`.
- Launch the same Serena distribution used by the project via `uvx --from git+https://github.com/oraios/serena`.
- Use `serena start-mcp-server --context codex --project-from-cwd` so every trusted checkout/worktree activates itself rather than hard-coding the primary checkout path.
- Set a bounded startup timeout that accommodates first-time `uvx` resolution.
- Validate the TOML and prove Codex discovers the server from the project config; smoke-test Serena startup/initialization against a temporary repo or this isolated worktree without altering operator data.
- Land the single-file config change through Gerrit with the required DCO and ticket trailer.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A trusted Codex session opened in any rebar checkout/worktree discovers an enabled `serena` STDIO MCP server from `.codex/config.toml`.
- [ ] The server uses Serena's `codex` context and auto-detects the active project from its process working directory; no user-specific rebar path is committed.
- [ ] A real Codex MCP listing/config parse and Serena initialization smoke test succeed.
- [ ] The existing project config remains valid and contains no secrets.
- [ ] Repository lint/typecheck/default tests remain green (the full gate may reuse a same-base result when the only additional change is static Codex configuration).

## References
Current Codex manual: project-scoped MCP servers are supported in `.codex/config.toml` for trusted projects; STDIO entries accept `command`, `args`, `cwd`, and `startup_timeout_sec`. Serena CLI help: `--context codex` and `--project-from-cwd` are supported.
data.title: Configure Codex to use the project's Serena MCP server
